notes.note: Reviewed the actual combined-source deltas after merging landed marketplace #3168 and upstream test cleanup #3182. RegistrySourceManager is composed with the existing installed experience owner; SkillService acquisition stays source-qualified with caller checks before/after awaits and before publication, while installed experience eligibility/execution admission remain unchanged. All source-management methods require access:manage plus operator principal; ordinary catalog/experience reads retain their existing tier. Combined module map/API/atlas and regenerated static MCP topics accurately route these owners; metadata source-binding unions retain both notes histories and original qualification limits. This review does not assert inventory caller projection, new live-model/native rendering, external package publication or promoted release.
